name: NextGen Golf
address: 1671 Hoffman Road, Suite 70, Green Bay, WI 54311

booking.howItWorks: Book simulator time online with 'Book Your Sim Time' and lessons with 'Book a Lesson'. For events and buyouts, use the Contact Us page or call 920-425-4038.

packages.name: Simulator Rental (per hour)
packages.description: TrackMan simulator time. Book more hours if you like. Games include Scrapyard and Streets of Neon, plus the TrackMan course library.

packages.name: Private Event / Full Buyout
packages.description: Event rentals for team building, happy hours, holiday parties, corporate outings, client entertaining, fundraising and birthdays. Full buyouts available. Food options include party platters, open bar and buffet-style packages. Contact the venue for pricing.

faq.q: Can I bring outside food or drink?
faq.a: Outside food and drink are not permitted.

faq.q: Do you serve food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes, there's a full bar and full kitchen, and food and drinks are served while you play.
Walk-ins are welcome. Booking ahead is recommended at peak times.

faq.q: How many players can share a bay?
How long does a round take?
faq.a: An 18-hole round typically takes 2 to 3 hours.

faq.q: Do you offer lessons and club fitting?
faq.a: Yes. There are TrackMan-based lessons with a golf pro, plus custom club and putter fitting. Book lessons online with 'Book a Lesson'.
The events page shows 'May - August' and 'Closed for Summer', so please check with the venue before planning a summer visit.
